concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-account-structure-resources]] — 2021-modified, 2026-09-15-captured current Platforms account-resource map for company/merchant/store, region-specific balance platforms, user account-holder/balance/legal-entity links and platform liable resources; it does not prove account or fund state.
warnings: Keep company and merchant accounts, stores, balance platforms, user account holders, balance accounts, legal entities, bank transfer instruments, issued payment instruments and platform liable resources distinct.

The 2021-modified page is scoped to the Platforms account-structure route; do not import Classic Platforms or Issuing product behavior, current regional availability, merchant-of-record identity or actual payment/settlement outcomes.
The liable-account deduction is conditional on user negative balances from refunds/chargebacks; it is not a universal reserve-account rule or proof of a debit.
